fusions.name: Snagging Swipe
fusions.desc: A swipe that deals 4 damage and tears at the target's armour, leaving it 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Barbed Finish
fusions.desc: Throws a barb that deals 18 damage to an enemy at or below 25% health and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Dragging Snag
fusions.desc: Sets a snag line 5 tiles long ahead of you for 6 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward.

fusions.name: Barbed Reflex
fusions.desc: When you take non-fire damage, a barb lashes the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 7 damage. Once every 10 seconds.
